'''Yett Cilgris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who owned and operated the modified [[Barloz-class medium freighter|''Barloz''-class freighter]] ''[[Birthright]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Cilgris was a member of the [[Cilgris family]], a family of Duros [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], and he was the son of [[Thes Cilgris]] and the cousin of [[Naul Cilgris]].
